verdict.rationale: Dover documents structured feedback forms so every interviewer scores candidates the same way, and Job Basic members can submit feedback without seeing other interviewers' feedback. It also offers a voluntary EEO survey that shows only aggregate results, with a Diversity (EEO) tab per job or across all jobs. However, the feedback isolation comes from a permission role rather than a submit-before-viewing ordering control, the EEO view is not broken down by funnel stage, and there is no anonymized or demographic-blind review mode. Missing for 10: demographic-blind/anonymized candidate review, DEI reporting segmented by funnel stage, an explicit feedback-ordering control for all interviewers, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, the platform helps reduce bias — structured feedback ordering, demographic-blind review options, and DEI reporting on the funnel

citations.quote: Create a form once, assign it to an interview stage, and every interviewer scores candidates the same way.
A member with **Job Basic** can submit feedback, but can't see other interviewers' feedback
You only see aggregate results, never individual answers.
the **Diversity (EEO)** tab shows the combined answers for all jobs or for one job, and the number of responses.
